value.rationale: The model paper identifies two sinks and finite-p multistability, leaving open whether the capacity for distinct stable stationary regimes is bounded. The exact cube-root growth and infinite fold ladder answer a natural amplitude-variation question with a global-in-parameter structural result. Three-dimensional stability proof is essential beyond elementary scalar sine-root counting. No real-world feasibility claims for arbitrarily large p.
